source.source_name: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File (EO BMF)

transport.record_path_note: Four regional CSV files, comma-delimited, header row present. Concatenate eo1..eo4 for national coverage.

snapshot.note: Convert each CSV row to one NDJSON record keyed by EIN; keep all 28 columns.

number_formats: EIN: keep as 9-char zero-padded string, never parse to int
ZIP: keep as string (leading zeros, ZIP+4)
ASSET_AMT/INCOME_AMT/REVENUE_AMT: integer whole USD, may be blank

mapping_rules.legal_name: Use NAME (uppercase). SORT_NAME is a secondary/chapter name -> alternate_names.
mapping_rules.status: Map STATUS '01' to active exempt status; this is tax-exempt status, not corporate standing.
mapping_rules.identifier: EIN -> identifiers.ein (9-char zero-padded string); strongest cross-source join key.
mapping_rules.activity: Prefer NTEE_CD over legacy ACTIVITY for classification.
mapping_rules.incorporation_date: Do NOT map RULING as incorporation_date; it is a YYYYMM recognition date -> dates.irs_ruling_date (approximate).

fixture_requirements: representative active nonprofit with financials populated
record with blank financial amounts (990-N filer)
record with NTEE_CD populated and one with NTEE_CD blank

live_test_plan.smoke: HTTP range request first ~4KB of eo1.csv to confirm header and field shape.
live_test_plan.full: Download and stream-parse eo1..eo4 only behind explicit env gates; do not load whole files into memory.
